div.head: Episc 12
div.ab: And riht is, þæt ne beo ænig metegyrd lengre þonne oðer, ac be þæs scriftes gemete ealle gescyft; ⁊ ælc gemet on his scriftscire ⁊ æghwylc gewihte beo be his dihte gescyft swiðe rihte; ⁊ gif ðær hwæt bisæces sy, séme se biscop.

And it is right that there not be any measuring stick longer than another, but all are to be standardised according to the confessor's measure; and each measure in his parish and each weight is to be standardised very precisely according to his direction; and if anything there is disputed, the bishop will judge.

Et iustum (rectum) est, ut non sit aliqua mensuralis uirga longior quam alia, sed per scryftes (episcopi) mensuram omnes institute sint; et omnis mensura (exequate) in sua scriftscira (per suam diocesim) et omne pondus sit (constet) secundum dictionem eius. Et si aliquid controuersiarum intersit, discernat episcopus.
